description: Lethares wears a knee-length burgundy-brown open-front coat with narrow gold geometric woven borders along the front edges, cuffs and hem. Underneath is an ivory linen tunic with a decorated split neckline and lower border. A narrow brown leather belt has a round bronze clasp and long plain hanging end with small metal fittings. Brown fitted trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots. Both feet are visible; his arms rest behind his back, hiding the hands naturally rather than cropping them. The garments are opaque and modestly ornamented. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
